facts.fact: Togo First reports a technical workshop on 4-7 May 2026 in Lomé, led by the Ministry of Health with GIZ and World Bank support, chose a federated architecture for the SIIG-AMU so existing platforms keep running while data is exchanged between hospitals, pharmacies, laboratories, managing bodies and insurers; the system is being prepared, with a roadmap and steering mechanisms worked on.
